description: Map the 35 AT5G03810/AT5G03820 differences onto the AlphaFold active site and superpose the two models
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
A=pd.read_csv("artifacts/AF_Q9FFN0_atoms.csv.gz")
B=[]
for l in open("artifacts/AF-Q9LZC5.pdb"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        B.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=l[17:20].strip(),resi=int(l[22:26]),
                      x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),z=float(l[46:54]),b=float(l[60:66])))
B=pd.DataFrame(B)
al=pd.read_csv("artifacts/align_AT5G03810_vs_AT5G03820.csv")
og=A[(A.resi==37)&(A.name=="OG")][["x","y","z"]].values[0]

# all polar donors within 8 A of Ser37 OG
c=A[A.name.isin(["N","ND2","NE2","NH1","NH2","NZ","OG","OG1","OH"])].copy()
c["dist"]=np.linalg.norm(c[["x","y","z"]].values-og,axis=1)
print("polar groups <8 A of Ser37 OG:")
print(c[c.dist<8].sort_values("dist")[["resn","resi","name","dist","b"]].to_string(index=False))

# per-residue min distance to Ser37 OG -> active-site pocket definition
pr=A.groupby(["resi","resn"]).apply(lambda g: np.linalg.norm(g[["x","y","z"]].values-og,axis=1).min()).reset_index(name="dmin")
pocket=pr[pr.dmin<=10].resi.tolist()
groove=pr[pr.dmin<=12].resi.tolist()
print("\nresidues with any atom <=10 A of catalytic Ser37 OG (active-site pocket): n=%d"%len(pocket))
print(sorted(pocket))

diff=al[(al.same==0)&(al.pos_a>0)]
dd=pr.set_index("resi").dmin
diff=diff.assign(dmin=[dd.get(int(p),np.nan) for p in diff.pos_a])
diff=diff.sort_values("dmin")
print("\n=== 35 paralog differences ranked by distance to catalytic Ser37 ===")
print(diff[["pos_a","aa_a","pos_b","aa_b","dmin"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\ndifferences inside 10 A pocket:", int((diff.dmin<=10).sum()), " inside 12 A:", int((diff.dmin<=12).sum()))
catalytic=[37,328,331,113,114,109,36]
print("catalytic/oxyanion positions among differences:", sorted(set(diff.pos_a.astype(int))&set(catalytic)))

# superpose CA of aligned pairs (Kabsch)
pairs=al[(al.pos_a>0)&(al.pos_b>0)]
Aca=A[A.name=="CA"].set_index("resi")[["x","y","z"]]
Bca=B[B.name=="CA"].set_index("resi")[["x","y","z"]]
P=np.array([Aca.loc[int(r.pos_a)].values for _,r in pairs.iterrows()])
Q=np.array([Bca.loc[int(r.pos_b)].values for _,r in pairs.iterrows()])
Pc=P-P.mean(0); Qc=Q-Q.mean(0)
U,S_,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc); dsign=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))
R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,dsign])@U.T
rms=np.sqrt(((Qc-(R@Pc.T).T)**2).sum(1).mean())
print("\nCA RMSD AT5G03810 vs AT5G03820 over %d aligned residues: %.2f A"%(len(P),rms))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.hist(pr.dmin,bins=30,color="#c8cdd4",label="all 353 residues")
ax.hist(diff.dmin.dropna(),bins=30,color="#d1495b",label="35 paralog differences")
ax.axvline(10,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.text(10.3,22,"10 A pocket",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("minimum distance to catalytic Ser37 OG (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("residues")
ax.set_title("AT5G03810 vs AT5G03820 differences\navoid the active site"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=axes[1]
x=np.arange(1,354); y=np.array([dd.get(i,np.nan) for i in x])
ax.plot(x,y,color="#9aa4b1",lw=0.8)
ax.scatter(diff.pos_a,diff.dmin,color="#d1495b",zorder=3,s=22,label="paralog difference")
for r_,lbl in [(37,"S37"),(113,"G113"),(328,"D328"),(331,"H331")]:
    ax.scatter([r_],[dd.get(r_)],marker="*",s=160,color="#1b4965",zorder=4)
    ax.annotate(lbl,(r_,dd.get(r_)),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(0,8),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#1b4965")
ax.axhline(10,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("AT5G03810 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("distance to Ser37 OG (A)")
ax.set_title("Catalytic machinery (stars) is invariant; differences are peripheral")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
